create_observation_queue: create an ObservationQueue instance to manage thread-safe event queues for game master entities
add_event_to_queue: add an event to the ObservationQueue for a specific entity or all players using the add method
get_and_clear_queue: retrieve and clear all queued events for a given entity using get_and_clear method
build_make_observation_component: build a MakeObservation component that generates player observations using a language model and queued events
reformat_observation_style: configure the MakeObservation component to reformat observations into a specified style using reformat_observations_in_specified_style
